pairs.target: yīwén zài zhǐ shàng xiě dé hěn qīngchǔ , zuórì qù chéngwài nà chù lù zhàn , jīnrì wǔhòu huílái , wǎnfàn cái yǒukōng . tǎ wéi kànguò , réng zài chī wǔfàn shí xiàyìshí jiāng pángbiān de dèngzǐ bōchūlái . mǐlā duānwǎn zuòxià , wèn nà shì gěi bāo , háishì gěi yígè yǐjīng shuō guòbùlái de rén .
pairs.english: Iven's note was clear: the station outside the city yesterday, back this afternoon, free only for dinner. Tavi had read it, yet reflexively pulled out the neighboring stool at lunch. Sitting with her bowl, Mira asked if it was for his bag or someone who'd already said he wouldn't come.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在纸上写得很清楚，昨日去城外那处路站，今日午后回来，晚饭才有空。塔维看过，仍在吃午饭时下意识将旁边的凳子拨出来。米拉端碗坐下，问那是给包，还是给一个已经说过不来的人。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dèngzǐ tuīhuí zhuōxià , shuō gěi zìjǐ shēntuǐ . mǐlā méi chāichuān , zhī bǎ sū yǐ de huíxìn dìgěi tā . xìn shì huí tā sì rìqián jì de tú , jīn zǎo dào , kāitóu xiān shuō kànjiàn mó hén de nà shuāngyǎn hái suàn néng yòng , jiēzhe biàn wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu jiāng shìjiàn shàng yuánlái de jìhào cādiào , zìjǐ xiàhuí háiyào nálái tóng jiù shù duì .
pairs.english: He pushed it back beneath the table: room for his legs. Mira didn't expose him, handing over Suyi's reply instead. It answered the drawings she had posted four days earlier, arriving this morning: the eyes inspecting wear were useful enough. Had Mira erased the original prototype marks? Suyi needed them for comparison with old readings.
pairs.hanzi: 他将凳子推回桌下，说给自己伸腿。米拉没拆穿，只把苏苡的回信递给他。信是回她四日前寄的图，今早到，开头先说看见磨痕的那双眼还算能用，接着便问她有没有将试件上原来的记号擦掉，自己下回还要拿来同旧数对。

pairs.target: shī shì hái méi zuò wán , sū yǐ bùkěn xiān gěi yígè " yǐ hǎo " de dáfù . tā dǎo tóngyì jiāng kě huàn de xiǎo tào lìng zuò liǎngzhī bèiyòng , shíjì huàn guò yǐhòu zài kàn huì buhuì bǎ yuánlái liú de kòngxì jǐdiào . mǐlā zài zhè duàn pángbiān huà le gè xiǎoquān , shuō zǒngsuàn yǒurén yě xiǎngyào yìzhī zhēn néng huàn chūlái de , bù zhī kuā huàn zì xiě dé hǎokàn .
pairs.english: Wet tests were unfinished, Suyi refusing an early “ready.” She agreed to make two spare replaceable bushings, checking after actual replacement whether they crowded the original clearance. Mira circled it: finally someone wanted one that could really be replaced, not just praise for writing the word replacement nicely.
pairs.hanzi: 湿试还没做完，苏苡不肯先给一个“已好”的答复。她倒同意将可换的小套另做两只备用，实际换过以后再看会不会把原来留的空隙挤掉。米拉在这段旁边画了个小圈，说总算有人也想要一只真能换出来的，不只夸换字写得好看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mō dào xìn wěi , yòu jiāng zhǐ zhéhuíqù , méi shànzì dú nà jǐháng . mǐlā kànjiàn , shuō kěyǐ kàn , sū yǐ zhǐshì zài wèn tā xuégōng de fàn shìbushì réng nàyàng dàn . tǎ wéi shuō fēng zhàn de tài xián , zìjǐ hái méi chī shùn , mǐlā biàn jiāng zhuōshàng de xiǎodié wǎng tā miànqián tuī , lǐtou liǎngkē suān guǒ , jiào tā bié yīn líkāi yígè dìfāng jiù jiāng nàlǐ de yán yě yídào dài huílái .
pairs.english: Reaching the letter's end, Tavi folded it without reading those lines uninvited. Mira gave permission: Suyi only asked whether academy food was still so bland. Wind Trestle's was too salty, Tavi said; he hadn't adjusted yet. Mira pushed him two sour fruits in a little dish: leaving a place didn't require bringing its salt along.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸到信尾，又将纸折回去，没擅自读那几行。米拉看见，说可以看，苏苡只是在问她学宫的饭是不是仍那样淡。塔维说风栈的太咸，自己还没吃顺，米拉便将桌上的小碟往他面前推，里头两颗酸果，叫他别因离开一个地方就将那里的盐也一道带回来。

pairs.target: wǔhòu liǎng rén qù zhǎo jiǎn lǎoshī , jiāng yǔtiān jìlù jiāoshàng . lǎoshī méi jiào tāmen zài pǎo yítàng còuqí sāngè rén de jiǎoyìn , xiān wèn quēxí de yīwén nà bùfen shìfǒu yǐjīng jiāodài qīng . mǐlā náchū tā xiěxià de yǔ zhōng rénliú yǔ qǔ pái de jìlù , shuō zài zhèlǐ , jīnrì shì tāmen tì tā dì lái , búshì shǎo le yígè rén biàn tì tā gǎidiào .
pairs.english: That afternoon they submitted the rain notes to Jian. He didn't demand a third person's visit for completeness, only asking whether absent Iven had accounted for his part. Mira produced his record of rainy traffic and sign removal: they delivered it for him today, not changed it because someone was missing.
pairs.hanzi: 午后两人去找简老师，将雨天记录交上。老师没叫他们再跑一趟凑齐三个人的脚印，先问缺席的伊文那部分是否已经交代清。米拉拿出他写下的雨中人流与取牌的记录，说在这里，今日是他们替他递来，不是少了一个人便替他改掉。

pairs.target: jiù péng zhèjiàn tí xiānzhào guānchá yǔ liǎnghuí tóngxué shì zǒu jiāo yífèn jiēduàn jìlù , yǔtiān bùnéng zhào qíngtiān zhàn de dìfāng xiě qīng ; duàn yí ruò yào zìjǐ gǎi děnghòu de ānpái , réng yóu tā tóng dāngbān de rén shāngliáng , búshì xuéshēng guà guò zhǐ biàn tì suǒyǒu lái chē dìng le guījǔ . lǎoshī ràng tāmen xiàhuí ná xīn bǎnběn xiān gěi tā kàn , jīnrì méi zài duō liúrén .
pairs.english: The shelter project would submit a staged report of observations and two student walkthroughs, clearly stating rain couldn't use sunny waiting positions. Duan and duty staff must decide actual waiting arrangements; hanging student paper didn't govern every cart. Jian asked to see the next version before it went back to her, keeping them no longer today.
pairs.hanzi: 旧棚这件题先照观察与两回同学试走交一份阶段记录，雨天不能照晴天站的地方写清；段姨若要自己改等候的安排，仍由她同当班的人商量，不是学生挂过纸便替所有来车定了规矩。老师让他们下回拿新版本先给她看，今日没再多留人。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián , yīwén guǒrán huílái , bèishàng nà zhī bāo bǐ zǒushí biě . tā shuō jiùfù sòng qù de shì jiù dǐ dān , huànhuílái yìzhāng tā xiǎng dàizǒu de kōng biǎo , rénjiā bùkěn jiāng zhèngzài yòng de nà běn gěi tā chāo , zhī ràng tā dāngchǎng hé le jǐchù , cuò de búshì shù , érshì tā yǐwéi liǎngliè kěyǐ zhíjiē bìng dào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Iven returned before dinner, his bag flatter. His uncle had delivered old orders; Iven got a blank form he'd wanted instead. Staff wouldn't let him copy their current ledger, only check several entries there. The mistake wasn't numbers, but thinking two columns could simply be combined.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前，伊文果然回来，背上那只包比走时瘪。他说舅父送去的是旧底单，换回来一张他想带走的空表，人家不肯将正在用的那本给他抄，只让他当场核了几处，错的不是数，而是他以为两列可以直接并到一起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù wèn , jiālǐrén qù yě bùkěn me . yīwén tái yǎn , shuō nà shì biérén de zhàng , jiùfù zhènghǎo yě zài děng rén huíqiān , búshì jìnmén jiù néng ràng rén bǎ guìzi dǎkāi . huà shuō dé yǒudiǎn yìng , mǐlā jiào tā xiān chī , gānghuílái jiù tì suǒyǒu qīnqi dá yíbiàn , tā de fàn yě yào liáng .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help asking: not even for family? Looking up, Iven said it was someone else's account. His uncle too was waiting for a countersignature, not walking in to demand an open cupboard. The words were sharp. Mira told him to eat: answering for all relatives on returning would cool his food too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住问，家里人去也不肯么。伊文抬眼，说那是别人的账，舅父正好也在等人回签，不是进门就能让人把柜子打开。话说得有点硬，米拉叫他先吃，刚回来就替所有亲戚答一遍，他的饭也要凉。

pairs.target: yīwén kàn le tā yìyǎn , yòu kànkàn tǎ wéi , hūrán xiào , shuō zìjǐ qíshí yǐjīng xiàng jiùfù wèn guò yíbiàn tóngyàng dehuà , āi le tóngyàng yíjù . tǎ wéi yě xiào le , wǎng zhuōxià yòng jiǎo jiāng zǎochén nà zhī kōng dèng bōchūlái , zhèhuí zhēnde yǒurén zuòxià .
pairs.english: Looking from her to Tavi, Iven suddenly laughed: he had actually asked his uncle the very same thing and received the same reply. Tavi laughed too, pulling out the morning's empty stool with his foot. This time someone really sat in it.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看了她一眼，又看看塔维，忽然笑，说自己其实已经向舅父问过一遍同样的话，挨了同样一句。塔维也笑了，往桌下用脚将早晨那只空凳拨出来，这回真的有人坐下。

pairs.target: chī wán , pà wò cóng pángbiān jīngguò , shuō yuànlǐ yǒurén ná jiù mùpiàn bǎi qí , shǎo yígè kěn shū de . yīwén lìkè qǐshēn , mǐlā shuō hái méi jiǎng shì shuí shǎo , tā yǐjīng guòqù zuò dào rén duìmiàn . tǎ wéi tóng tā zhàn zài pángbiān kàn , dìyījú yīwén jiù shū , dìèrjú hái méi xià wán , sāngè rén yǐ wèi yìméi gāibugāi tuì de qízǐ zhēng qǐlái .
pairs.english: After dinner Pavo passed: someone in the courtyard was playing with old wooden pieces and needed someone willing to lose. Iven rose at once, already seated opposite before Mira could ask who was needed. Tavi watched with her: Iven lost the first game; before the second finished, all three argued whether a piece should retreat.
pairs.hanzi: 吃完，帕沃从旁边经过，说院里有人拿旧木片摆棋，少一个肯输的。伊文立刻起身，米拉说还没讲是谁少，他已经过去坐到人对面。塔维同她站在旁边看，第一局伊文就输，第二局还没下完，三个人已为一枚该不该退的棋子争起来。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ fēng dà , qípán yòng shítou yā zhe , dēng cóng chuāng lǐ zhào chū yìjiǎo . shuí yě méi tí zhè suànbusuàn hé zuò , mǐlā jiāng nà méi qízǐ niē zài zhǐ jiān , jiào yīwén xiān chéngrèn zìjǐ fāngcái shuō de shì lìng yìtiáo guījǔ . tǎ wéi shēnshǒu qù ná , bèi tā pāi kāi , sān rén xiào dé jīhū jiāng pán biān de shítou pèng luò .
pairs.english: Wind blew through the courtyard; stones weighed the board down, a window lighting one corner. Nobody asked whether it counted as joint work. Pinching the piece, Mira told Iven to admit he had quoted another rule just now. She slapped Tavi's reaching hand away, all three laughing enough to nearly knock a board-edge stone off.
pairs.hanzi: 院里风大，棋盘用石头压着，灯从窗里照出一角。谁也没提这算不算合做，米拉将那枚棋子捏在指间，叫伊文先承认自己方才说的是另一条规矩。塔维伸手去拿，被她拍开，三人笑得几乎将盘边的石头碰落。
